docs/RESEARCH_GOALS.md.text: | 2026-11-26 | [When a local reader's view settles, from the start alone](../research/SETTLE-BOUND-20261126-001/decision.md) | G17, G1 | Obstruction learned | A check by the thread at the coordinator's go-ahead (computed; referee pending). A bound frozen on starts of up to four knots, a view settling within the start's largest block plus 5 rounds (plus 7 with parents), fails on 41 of 1,556 five-knot and 6 of 387 held-out six-knot starts of a dimension under not-all-equal (11 and 2 under parity). Most late starts narrow to a single birth a round before going on as a lone knot, late even with no large block. The look-alike pair rule holds wherever views settle by the cut. Successor: the round of the last merge as the bound. |

maximal_sets_and_binomial_scope.qualification: A common-neighbour set supplies candidate pairs. A larger joining group can cover those pairs. For one maximal set all candidates inside it are pair groups, subject to the shortage rule. Extra loose distinctions produce offshoots and change the whole birth count. The earlier isolated bursts use the branch system with their measured loose counts, alongside the proof's other premises.
